encoder: 12 frozen Structural checkpoints; 4 held-out vehicles x 3 seeds
target_data_authorized: User explicitly allows a separate confirmed-benign target capture
calibration_capture: canonical train_01 attack-free capture with largest recording suffix for each vehicle; verify all labels benign; never choose boundaries from attack labels
calibration_selection: 2000 equally spaced distinct windows across entire reserved capture; even indices for normalization (1000), odd for threshold (1000). Requires observation of full capture, not 2000 initial windows.
evaluation_exclusion: exclude ENTIRE reserved calibration capture and every identical alias; report separate exact-content-overlap-free sensitivity
overlap_detection: SHA256 of aligned W64 identifier/DLC/payload bytes, excluding timestamps/labels; overlap reference all 2000 calibration windows
threshold: conservative order statistic ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)), nextafter above score, no target attack labels
normalization: source and target fit only own reserved benign first-half selection; diagonal variance floor or symmetric covariance whitening with fixed0.1 isotropic shrinkage; clip normalized coordinates to +/-10
source_fit: reuse matched sampled source training windows; source vehicle x binary label weights; no target samples in eraser/PCA/INLP/task head
LEACE: weighted empirical conditional vehicle-residual concepts; shared affine eraser fitted only to three sources
INLP: conditional LR vehicle decoders C0.1; up to200 samples per source vehicle/class; remove decoder rowspaces until8 dimensions or no remaining direction; fixed protocol, no target tuning
task_head: weighted source StandardScaler + LR C1 max_iter2000
probes: matched balanced vehicle x attack samples, exclude calibration captures and aligned content overlap; LR + MLP(64,32), max_iter300; vehicle probes learned/constant/permuted; attack LR learned; inspect embedding and deployed scalar risk separately
primary_success_check: vehicle probes of the transformed embedding approach chance without loss of target detection; risk-only probe reduction does NOT establish encoder independence
limitations: record-disjoint calibration is verifiable; independent driving sessions are not established
observed vehicles were used during previous research
zero mean/covariance or linear erasure is not nonlinear independence
no distribution-free FAR guarantee under dependent/drifting CAN windows
scalar risk compression is reported separately from64-dimensional embedding
new target-calibrated regime cannot be called strict zero-shot
